identity: Current RDC125HD visual exterior, related52PF1825 for visible isolated details only

frame.origin: Existing barclamp guide; estimated assembly relation only

geometry_scope.included: Finite upper/lateral skin with independently authored longitudinal crown/lower rail/shoulder/knee controls. Visible skin starts/ends at declared unresolved cut boundaries.
excluded: Cap or filler neck before shell review
Paint or lettering before gray/reflection review

construction_assumptions.units: m for editable construction only, not measured tank dimensions
construction_assumptions.ranges_are: Design exploration bounds only, not physical uncertainty intervals or manufacturer claims
construction_assumptions.bilateral_initialization: Initial main skin symmetric because no reliable difference is measured. Left/right controls kept separately editable, symmetry explicitly estimated. No random asymmetry added.

surface_method: Piecewise cubic Hermite longitudinal interpolants for crown, lower rail, halfwidth, front/rear sweep and cross-section fullness.
Cross profile separates crown, shoulder, full flank, knee return and lower edge; not a family of repeated ellipses.
Evaluate normals from the parametric surface; finite wall is a normal offset. Close only thickness at the declared boundary, not the unknown lower tank/pan volume.
Do not close a free rear end across the seat occlusion or infer an OEM mount.

comparison.native_profile_overlays: 1000x700 with fixed R00/R04 working cameras from reference-camera-studies; print their existing residuals and camera limitations unchanged.
comparison.second_projection: Repeat with fixed50mm perspective hypotheses; no point-fit to tank used to claim calibration.
comparison.independent_oblique: Observe related product three-quarter shape; an illustrative candidate camera is estimated separately, no false pixel threshold.
required_previews: whole gray left/right and upper oblique
cross sections and actual cut-boundary view
comparison.deformation_rule: Change a section only if several views support the direction; retain camera/occlusion ambiguity instead of absorbing R04 guide error.
comparison.acceptance: No new physical cote, calibratedphoto or G2/G3 pass from a small projected residual.

details_sequence: Filler mouth/neck, nearby holes and visible flange/ear individually after their own detail reading
Red finish original estimated and original WEWA lettering replacing BOXER
Seat18 next; mounting compatibility still open
technical_checks: Positive nonzero triangle area source and actual export
Closed wall, not closed fluid tank; positive wall volume
No duplicate or self-intersecting boundary offsets
UV area and normal/face dot actual GLB
Actual whole camera preflight before expensive rendering
